newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc posts modest gains on dollar, mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc posts modest gains on dollar, mark.

text.p: 1545 GMT - The Swiss franc closed slightly firmer on the dollar and the mark after the market shook off the dollar's brief attempt at an advance after a greater than expected rise in U.S. non-farm payrolls.

Dealesrs, who noted that the franc managed to stay within its range, was likely to hold near these in the near term. * Dollar closes at 1.4822/4828 francs vs prior 1.4900/4910. * Mark ends at 86.30/33 centimes vs 86.65/68. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
